evidence.observation: H701 reads 443.6 °C versus H702 at 70.5 °C and vessel at 72.0 °C; a large heater-temperature discrepancy is present from the first observation.
The discrepancy persists: H701 is 443.6 °C, H702 69.7 °C, and vessel 72.4 °C. These readings do not distinguish actual localized overheating from a temperature-measurement fault.
Distillate and reflux flows briefly rise to 0.8 and 3.1, with buffer differential pressure at 4.5 mbar; all return near preceding values at the next event.

System pressure is 500.7 mbar, column differential pressure 0.6 mbar, buffer differential pressure 3.0 mbar, and cooling-water flow 7.1; no sustained pressure excursion accompanies the high H701 reading.

args.missing_evidence: H701 operating setpoint and permitted temperature range, heater power/status, and an independent heater-temperature measurement are needed to distinguish overheating from sensor error; no composition measurement is available to assess separation.
